events.command: head -50 README.md inventory_reconciliation.py shipment_planner.py && git log --oneline -5 && ls -la .nohooks

git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h and drop stale-snapshot fallback

Bump CACHE_TTL_SECONDS from 900 to 3600 so cached pricing is held for a
full hour instead of 15 minutes, cutting repeat lookups against the
upstream feed by 4x.

With the longer TTL the cache itself covers the gap when the feed runs
late, so the previous-snapshot fallback in lookup() is redundant. It had
no remaining callers in this repo, and serving a snapshot of unbounded
age risked returning prices staler than the TTL was meant to allow.
EOF
